This city was the capital of a state that had a ruler who supposedly rejected Islam because of its prohibition on drinking alcohol. It's not Novgorod, but a grand prince of this city was named Yaroslav the Wise. This city was the capital of a state that was Christianized under Vladimir the Great and was called this city's namesake "Rus." For 10 points, name this capital of Ukraine.
